Willow is the AI Basecamp for the enterprise : a unified Agentic Access Platform where every AI agent gets a real identity, scoped access to exactly the tools its task requires, runtime guardrails, and a full audit trail tied to a human.
Willow(fka Webrix), a Herzliya, Israel-based provider of an agentic access platform, raised $7M in Seed funding.
The platform also includes a marketplace with over 1,000 ready-to-use connectors , more than 100 skills, and more than 100 plugins

INXM , a Berlin-based startup developing AI-powered process automation technology for enterprise and industrial operations

The company positions itself at the intersection of enterprise software and AI deployment, focused on making AI operationally reliable rather than simply demonstrating capability in controlled settings.
At the core of the platform is the INXM Orchestrator, which converts user intent into executable plans and coordinates tasks across systems, people, and processes.

The core product, Orchestrator, connects existing enterprise platforms such as ERP, PLM, MES, and QMS systems and automates complex workflows across all of them without replacing what companies already have in place.

Odyssey, a world model AI startup founded by self-driving vehicle pioneers CEO Oliver Cameron and CTO Jeff Hawke
Odyssey ML, co-founded by self-driving veterans Oliver Cameron and Jeff Hawke, is now valued at $1.45 billion including the new capital.
Odyssey's flagship product, Odyssey-2, generates interactive simulations from text or image prompts with streaming latency under 50 milliseconds.
Its Starchild-1 model includes audio and spatial reasoning simultaneously.
